title: Assay calibration and samples
bodyMd:
### Laboratory protocol
A sample’s reported activity equals its raw instrument reading minus the blank reading measured in the same run. A corrected activity of at least12 units is classified as elevated. No rounding is needed for the readings below.

### Run records
| Run | Blank | Sample | Raw reading |
|---|---:|---|---:|
| Morning |4|Lumen|15|
| Morning |4|Mica|18|
| Afternoon |7|Nori|18|
| Afternoon |7|Ochre|20|

### Technician’s note
A draft summary calls Mica and Nori equally active because their raw readings match. The instrument’s afternoon baseline was higher, which is why each run has its own blank. No conclusions about biological causes are to be drawn from this exercise.
